::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight 1 Samuel records Israel's transition from judges to kings, highlighting the rise of Samuel, Saul, and David. The book teaches that God looks upon the heart and raises leaders according to His purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
1 Samuel 1:27
For this child I prayed
### Why This Verse Hannah's testimony ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Hannah's prayer and the birth of Samuel. The key verse highlights God's ability to answer prayer and reverse impossible circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
1 Samuel 2:30
Them that honor Me I will honor
### Why This Verse Major theological statement ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Hannah's song and contrasts faithful and corrupt leadership. The key verse reveals God's sovereignty in exalting the humble and humbling the proud. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
1 Samuel 3:10
Speak, LORD, for thy servant heareth
### Why This Verse Samuel's call ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts God's call of Samuel. The key verse emphasizes the importance of listening and responding to God's voice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
1 Samuel 4:21
Ichabod
### Why This Verse The glory has departed ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Israel's defeat and the capture of the ark. The key verse demonstrates that God's presence cannot be manipulated through religious symbols. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
1 Samuel 5:3
Dagon fallen before the ark
### Why This Verse Famous demonstration of God's supremacy ### Chapter Insight This chapter shows God's power over the Philistine god Dagon. The key verse reveals God's supremacy over all false gods. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
1 Samuel 6:20
Who is able to stand before the LORD?
### Why This Verse Response to divine holiness ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the return of the ark to Israel. The key verse highlights God's holiness and the need to approach Him with reverence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
1 Samuel 7:12
Ebenezer
### Why This Verse "Thus far the LORD has helped us" ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Israel's repentance and victory at Mizpah. The key verse commemorates God's help and faithfulness through the Ebenezer stone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
1 Samuel 8:7
They have rejected Me from reigning over them
### Why This Verse Israel demands a king ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Israel's request for a king. The key verse reveals that Israel's demand reflected a rejection of God's kingship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
1 Samuel 9:6
There is a man of God in this city
### Why This Verse Saul seeks Samuel ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces Saul and God's preparation of him as king. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereign direction of seemingly ordinary events. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
1 Samuel 10:9
God gave him another heart
### Why This Verse Saul's transformation ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Saul's anointing and public selection as king. The key verse emphasizes that leadership comes from God's appointment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
1 Samuel 11:13
The LORD has wrought salvation in Israel
### Why This Verse Saul's early success ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Saul's early victory over the Ammonites. The key verse highlights God's deliverance through the king He provided. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
1 Samuel 12:24
Fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully
### Why This Verse Samuel's farewell exhortation ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Samuel's farewell address. The key verse calls Israel to fear the Lord and serve Him faithfully. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
1 Samuel 13:14
A man after His own heart
### Why This Verse Defining description of David ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Saul's unlawful sacrifice and disobedience. The key verse demonstrates that obedience is more important than expediency. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
1 Samuel 14:6
Nothing restrains the LORD from saving
### Why This Verse Jonathan's faith ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Jonathan's faith-driven victory over the Philistines. The key verse teaches that God can save regardless of human resources. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
1 Samuel 15:22
To obey is better than sacrifice
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Samuel ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Saul's rejection as king. The key verse emphasizes that obedience is better than sacrifice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
1 Samuel 16:7
Man looks on the outward appearance
### Why This Verse God chooses David ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes David's anointing. The key verse reveals that God looks at the heart rather than outward appearance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
1 Samuel 17:45
I come in the name of the LORD
### Why This Verse David before Goliath ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's victory over Goliath. The key verse highlights faith in God's power rather than confidence in human strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
1 Samuel 18:1
The soul of Jonathan was knit to David
### Why This Verse Famous friendship passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes David's rise and Saul's growing jealousy. The key verse shows how God's favor distinguished David. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
1 Samuel 19:23
The Spirit of God came upon him
### Why This Verse Saul among the prophets again ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Saul's increasing attempts to kill David. The key verse demonstrates God's protection of His chosen servant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
1 Samuel 20:42
The LORD be between me and thee
### Why This Verse David and Jonathan covenant ### Chapter Insight This chapter highlights the covenant friendship between David and Jonathan. The key verse emphasizes loyalty, love, and faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
1 Samuel 21:9
There is none like that
### Why This Verse Goliath's sword ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's flight from Saul. The key verse demonstrates God's provision during seasons of hardship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
1 Samuel 22:2
Everyone in distress gathered to him
### Why This Verse Beginning of David's mighty men ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Saul's massacre of the priests. The key verse illustrates the tragic consequences of unchecked jealousy and rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
1 Samuel 23:16
Jonathan strengthened his hand in God
### Why This Verse Encouragement in adversity ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's protection of Keilah and continued flight. The key verse emphasizes seeking God's guidance in difficult decisions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
1 Samuel 24:6
I will not stretch forth my hand
### Why This Verse David spares Saul ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts David sparing Saul's life. The key verse demonstrates respect for God's authority despite personal injustice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
1 Samuel 25:32
Blessed be the LORD who sent thee
### Why This Verse Abigail's wisdom ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David, Nabal, and Abigail. The key verse highlights wisdom and restraint in preventing needless vengeance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
1 Samuel 26:23
The LORD renders to every man
### Why This Verse David's integrity ### Chapter Insight This chapter again shows David sparing Saul. The key verse reinforces David's trust in God rather than taking matters into his own hands. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
1 Samuel 27:1
David said in his heart
### Why This Verse Turning point toward Philistine refuge ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's refuge among the Philistines. The key verse reveals the complexity of living by faith during uncertainty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
1 Samuel 28:15
Why hast thou disturbed me?
### Why This Verse Samuel and Saul at Endor ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Saul's visit to the medium of Endor. The key verse demonstrates the despair that results from rejecting God's guidance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
1 Samuel 29:6
As the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright
### Why This Verse Philistine assessment of David ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's dismissal from the Philistine army. The key verse reveals God's providential protection from compromise. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
1 Samuel 30:6
David encouraged himself in the LORD
### Why This Verse Widely quoted encouragement verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes David's victory after the attack on Ziklag. The key verse emphasizes finding strength in the Lord during crisis. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
1 Samuel 31:4
Saul fell upon his sword
### Why This Verse Death of Saul ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Saul's death. The key verse marks the tragic conclusion of a king who repeatedly rejected God's authority. :::
